# version_at { #crossrepo.remote.version_at }

```python
crossrepo.remote.version_at(entry, ref, client=None)
```

Read one named version of a file on GitHub without listing the others.

Two requests, whatever the length of the history: the commit, and the file
as of that commit. Listing every version to search it would cost a request
per version.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**entry**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Entry](`crossrepo.model.Entry`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Entry whose content to read.

<code>[**ref**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Commit sha, a unique prefix of one, a tag or a branch.

<code>[**client**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[Client](`crossrepo.github.Client`)\]]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Client to read with. Defaults to a new one.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[Version](`crossrepo.model.Version`)\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The version, or `None` when `ref` names nothing that holds this file.
